description: This file contains unit tests for credit-related utility functions in a Node.js project. It tests functions such as getCreditsPerUsd, usdToCredits, and formatCredits, which are imported from a 'credits' module.

methods.name: getCreditsPerUsd
methods.description: Retrieves the number of credits per USD, defaults if environment variable not set.

methods.name: usdToCredits
methods.description: Converts a USD amount to credits, rounding as necessary.

methods.name: formatCredits
methods.description: Formats a credits amount as a string with a suffix.
